luke.description: The Luke instance attached to this component.

parentSelector.description: Selector for the Gen AI side panel

spinner.description: The spinner that masks the component when data is loading

renderingSelectors.description:
An array of selectors used to determine whether the page/component exist or is rendered.  These selectors will be searched
for within the {@link #parentSelector}.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time that Luke will retry an action

actionGroupButtonSelector.description: Selector for the action group button

sidePanelHeaderSelector.description: Selector for the side panel header

closeIconSelector.description:
The selector for the close icon.  Only present if the {@link UiSdlSidePanel#header} has a
{@link UiSdlSidePanelHeader#closeIcon} defined.

openIconSelector.description:
The selector for the open icon.  Only present if the {@link UiSdlSidePanel#header} has a
{@link UiSdlSidePanelHeader#openIcon} defined.

sidePanelOpenSelector.description: The selector of the side panel when the side panel is open

cancelServerResponseButtonSelector.description: Selector for the Gen AI side panel cancel query button
